item.tib: srid rgyal zlog pa'i sngags sham gnam lcags 'khor lo thog mda' 'bar ba
item.coloph: ye shes mkha' 'gro chen po yi/ zhal lungaji bzhin ma nor bar/ nges med rnal 'byor bdag gis bkod/ dge des bon bstan dar zhing rgyas/ 'gro kun sems can thams cad kun/ rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu gyur cig sa ma ya / rgya rgya rgya//
